SELECT T.* FROM (SELECT M.*, C.CONFIGNAME, R.QTY, R.SUCCESSQTY, CASE WHEN R.SUCCESSQTY = 0 THEN '0' WHEN R.QTY - R.SUCCESSQTY > 0 THEN '1' ELSE '2' END SUCCESSSTATUS FROM T_CORE_EMAIL M, T_CORE_EMAIL_CONFIG C, (SELECT R.EMAILID, COUNT(1) QTY, SUM(CASE WHEN R.SUCCESS='1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) SUCCESSQTY FROM T_CORE_EMAIL_RECEIPENT R GROUP BY R.EMAILID) R WHERE M.ID = R.EMAILID AND M.CONFIGID = C.ID) T
ORDER BY
T.ID

SELECT M.*, C.CONFIGNAME, R.QTY, R.SUCCESSQTY, CASE WHEN R.SUCCESSQTY = 0 THEN '0' WHEN R.QTY - R.SUCCESSQTY > 0 THEN '1' ELSE '2' END SUCCESSSTATUS FROM T_CORE_EMAIL M, T_CORE_EMAIL_CONFIG C, (SELECT R.EMAILID, COUNT(1) QTY, SUM(CASE WHEN R.SUCCESS='1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) SUCCESSQTY FROM T_CORE_EMAIL_RECEIPENT R GROUP BY R.EMAILID) R WHERE M.ID = R.EMAILID AND M.CONFIGID = C.ID AND M.ID = #{id}
